market_question: Will Solana dip to $20 by December 31, 2026?
reasoning: Solana has experienced >85% drawdowns in past bear markets, falling from ~$260 to ~$8. The event window captures a likely post-peak period if the cycle rolls over in late 2025, making a revisit to low levels plausible. Yet growing ecosystem strength and institutional flows reduce the odds. I estimate a 14% chance, above the market’s 9.5%.
evidence_points: SOL fell from $260 (Nov 2021) to $8 (Dec 2022), an ≈97% peak-to-trough decline.
The 2025–2026 window aligns with the typical crypto bear phase after the 2024 halving.
Binance spot low of $20 implies an 85%+ drop from current levels (~$150–200), which remains within historical extremes.
sources_consulted: Crypto market cycle analysis (BTC halving cycles)
